name: Ad Matrem Vocatus
descriptionTemplate: Thais gains [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus. {Rouse}: Immediately gain 1 {Scion of Purity}. Whenever a Posse is used, transform an {Embryo} in hand into a {Scion of Purity}.
lore:
Nurture, be born, proliferate.
In the gradually dissolving reality, in the dimming world, in the soon-to-be-born void.
Your existence is the fruit of Mother's sacrifice and the cause of Mother's continuity.
Holy children, be reborn in the new world—be reborn in that pure, fear-obliterated new world.

patch.descriptionTemplate: Thais gains [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus. {Rouse}: Immediately gain 1 {Scion of Purity}. Whenever a Posse is released, transform 1 {Embryo} in hand into 1 {Scion of Purity}. {Ritual of Abundance} additionally places 1 extra copy into hand.
